description:
Change the world. Love your job. 

 TI is the world's leading battery gauge IC supplier, used in products all over the world including phones, notebook computers, and industrial applications. These gauges are MCUs that run application firmware, that includes industry-leading and patented algorithms to determine the state of charge and health of rechargeable batteries. The Battery Gauges Firmware team develops both the gauge application firmware for various customers as well SDKs for customers who want to develop their own gauge firmware and algorithms for TI's Guaging ICs. 

 About the job: 

  

 The software development engineer is responsible for the development of ROM code, low-level device drivers ( both bare-metal & RTOS based), tool-chain support, SDK development & custom firmware creation for major OEMs. This includes the development for new core devices as well as supporting existing SDK and firmware customers.

 
 Design software solutions with a test-driven development approach to validate functionality, ensure code coverage, and drive continuous improvement

 Define and own software component for Gauging ICs, be it ROM, device drivers, SDK, gauging application and its features, from requirements gathering, planning, development, testing, and release

 Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align on software solution strategy and customer needs

 Debug and address software issues during development and in production systems to support customers

 Conduct thorough code reviews and promote best practices and coding standards

 Also, ramp up on battery gauging technology to be able to work effectively with the customers.

  

 

 Minimum Requirements: 
 Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field of study
 4+ years of relevant experience with hands on low-level driver and/or ROM and firmware development 
  
 Preferred Qualifications: 
 Experience with developing ROM and/or low-level device drivers, be it bare-metal or RTOS based drivers
 Experience of working with RTOS like FreeRTOS etc
 Experience developing and debugging firmware on embedded microcontrollers
 Experience with security and authentication in a microcontroller
 Experience in software test methodologies for embedded applications
 Agile firmware development experience
 Experience with version control systems such as Git
 Strong verbal and written communication skills
 Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions
 Ability to take the initiative and drive for high-quality results
 Strong time management and organizational skills that enable on-time project delivery
 Be able to bring new ideas for product innovation and help improve software development processes
 
 
 
 
 Why TI? 
 

 
 
 The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us.

 Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture .

 At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings .

 
 

 

 
 
 About Texas Instruments 
 

 
 Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere. Learn more at  TI.com .
 

 

 
 Texas Instruments is an equal opportunity employer and supports a diverse, inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, creed, disability, genetic information, national origin, gender, gender identity and expression, age, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. 
 

 
 If you are interested in this position, please apply to this requisition.
